item.title: Mainly fair weather expected in most parts of the island
item.description: Mainly fair weather will prevail over the most parts of the island, the Department of Meteorology said. MORE..

item.title: World Economic Forum boss quits after review of Epstein links
item.description: The president and CEO of the World Economic Forum (WEF), Borge Brende, has resigned after a review into his links to the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. MORE..

item.title: President to inaugurate Himikama national programme in Anuradhapura today
item.description: The inaugural ceremony of the national programme for the presentation of Himikama freehold title deeds to the general public will be held in Anuradhapura today (27). MORE..

item.title: Pakistan PM says can crush aggressors after Afghan strikes
item.description: Pakistan s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said on Friday his country s armed forces can “crush” aggressors, following air strikes on neighbouring Afghanistan. MORE..

item.title: Podi Lassie arrested without Interpol Red Notice, police reveal more details
item.description: A total of 14 suspects have been brought back to Sri Lanka without Interpol Red Notices, Police Media Spokesperson Assistant Superintendent of Police F. U. Wootler revealed. MORE..

item.title: Podi Lassie to be handed over to Galle Crimes Division
item.description: Arumahandi Janith Madhusankha de Silva, alias “Podi Lassie” — a high-profile alleged drug trafficker wanted by police in connection with multiple homicides — was escorted from the Bandaranaike International Airport following his arrival on the island early this morning (27). MORE..

item.title: Ministry calls for report to probe environmental impact of Kerawalapitiya garbage dump fire
item.description: The Ministry of Environment has taken steps to call for a comprehensive report to investigate the fire that broke out at the Kerawalapitiya garbage dumping yard and its subsequent environmental impact. MORE..

item.title: Podi Lassie taken to Galle Crimes Division for further investigations
item.description: Janith Madhusankha, alias “Podi Lassie” — a high-profile alleged drug trafficker wanted by police in connection with multiple homicides — who was arrested in India and brought back to Sri Lanka early this morning (27), has been handed over to the Galle District Crimes Division for further investigation. MORE..

item.title: Sri Lanka officially launches Digital Nomad Visa facility; first recipients welcomed
item.description: The official launch of the Digital Nomad Visa (DNV) facility in Sri Lanka was held at the “Silk Route” passenger terminal of the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in Katunayake. MORE..

item.title: Special scholarship programme for uni. students affected by Cyclone Ditwah
item.description: The Board of Trustees of the Lalith Athulathmudali Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund has decided to introduce a special scholarship programme to be awarded on a one-time basis. MORE..
